_comment: Generated character-name pool for presence bots (in-world citizen names).
(fetched 2026-10-03). NOTE: despite the filename that list is a large
English wordlist, not usernames; used only as an alphabet filter.
Selection rule: keep a word only when it BOTH (a) appears in that wordlist and
(b) appears in AAEmu.Game/Data/Creatures.xml as the GIVEN-name slot of a
two-word NPC title ("Role Given", e.g. "Cook Royster", "Mayor Gott") --
names the game's own 1.2 NPC data already uses for people. Words that
survived the mechanical filter but are roles/creatures/adjectives
(Blacksmith, Golem, Warrior, Mage, ...) were then dropped by hand.
Result: 123 names, every one matching NameManager's ^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,18}$.
Single words only -- the character-name regex forbids spaces, so NPC-style
"Given Family" pairs cannot be used verbatim as character names.
Hand-maintainable: edit the array freely. BotNameGenerator validates every
entry against the NameManager rules at load and drops malformed ones.
